title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: effect of the MTP draft length (--spec-draft-n-max)
setup: Temporary llama-server router (build 11721, Vulkan, iGPU only), copy of the production preset with only the draft length changed. Fixed sampling seeds; the model is loaded from scratch for each variant and warmed up before measuring. Weights resided in shared GPU memory (see docs/en/02-methodology.md).
unit: tokens/s of generation as reported by the server (timings.predicted_per_second)

loads.copy: verbatim copy of a ~1,400-character code fragment
loads.edit: rewrite the same fragment adding a one-line comment above each function
loads.agent: one agent step with tool definitions and bounded reasoning
loads.reasoning: free reasoning, bounded to a few hundred tokens

derived.note: Five-load mean: 58.3 vs 50.8 tok/s (+15%). Common loads (copy, edit, reasoning): 62.1 vs 50.4 tok/s (+23%).

source: Internal report 29 (2026-10-23), section 'Qwen3.6: speculative decoding MTP'.
